DevGen.AI: in-house AI tool built on OpenAI GPT models that translates legacy code (e.g. COBOL, Perl) into plain-English specifications to accelerate modernization. Reviewed ~9 million lines of code and saved an estimated 280,000 developer hours in 2025. [OpenAI GPT (in-house tool)]

deployments_detail.use: Next Best Action (NBA): internally built machine-learning recommendation engine that delivers timely, personalized investment ideas and outreach messages to clients and prospects, guiding advisor communications. [in-house machine learning]

AI @ Morgan Stanley Assistant: a GPT-4-powered internal chatbot for Wealth Management financial advisors that surfaces answers from the firm's ~100,000 internal research reports and documents. Reached ~98% adoption among FA teams. [OpenAI GPT-4]

AI @ Morgan Stanley Debrief: OpenAI-powered meeting notetaker that, with client consent, records/transcribes client meetings, generates notes, action items and draft follow-up emails for financial advisors. Rolled out to roughly 15,000 advisors. [OpenAI Whisper + GPT-4]

AskResearchGPT: generative-AI assistant for Institutional Securities (Investment Banking, Sales & Trading, Research) that surfaces and distills insights from Morgan Stanley's research library of tens of thousands of reports. [OpenAI (ChatGPT/GPT-4)]

Aladdin Wealth 'Auto Commentary': generative-AI feature on Morgan Stanley's Portfolio Risk Platform that turns portfolio analytics and client-level preferences into tailored narrative insights and talking points for advisors. Morgan Stanley was the first client to implement it. [BlackRock Aladdin Wealth]

Opening wealth-management/stock-plan platforms (Shareworks and Equate) to external autonomous AI agents via Model Context Protocol (MCP), letting clients' AI agents pull data and insights directly from Morgan Stanley platforms to scale the workplace stock-plan wealth funnel. [Model Context Protocol (MCP)]

AI-based fraud detection and real-time transaction monitoring using Brighterion's artificial intelligence to detect fraud and money laundering; Morgan Stanley recognized Brighterion with its first Fintech Award for the deployed anti-fraud software. [Brighterion (Mastercard)]
